packageRules.description: One automerged PR per repo per week for every non-major update. Renovate only bundles updates it finds in the same run, so the weekly window — not the grouping alone — is what collapses the MR count. A repo that sets its own groupName (haptic's kubernetes/haproxy/spoa bundles) keeps a separate PR and inherits this schedule.
Packages this group publishes itself skip the soak — minimumReleaseAge guards against a compromised third-party release and buys nothing here, while delaying an internal fix reaching its consumer.
